experiences.summary: Backend engineer at a small IoT-networking startup building the device fleet API.

bullets.text: Built a FastAPI service that ingests telemetry from 12k edge devices at 4k msgs/sec.
Cut p99 API latency from 480ms to 110ms by adding a Redis read-through cache.
Designed the device-provisioning flow using mutual TLS and short-lived certificates.
Wrote the on-call runbook and set up Prometheus alerting for the ingest pipeline.

experiences.summary: Led a 3-student team studying congestion control over software-defined networks.

bullets.text: Led 3 students building an SDN testbed on Mininet to benchmark BBR vs CUBIC.
Automated 200+ topology experiments and analyzed throughput/fairness in Python.
Co-authored a workshop paper on queue-management under bursty traffic.

experiences.summary: Application-security intern on the product security team at a fintech.

bullets.text: Triaged 60+ findings from SAST/DAST scans and filed prioritized remediation tickets.
Built a Burp extension that flagged missing auth checks on internal API routes.
Ran a threat-modeling session for a new payments microservice.
Shipped a React dashboard used by 40 internal staff to track support tickets.
Added TypeScript types across the frontend, removing a class of runtime errors.

bullets.text: Captured per-process TCP flows with an eBPF program and exported Prometheus metrics.
Built Grafana dashboards showing connection churn and top talkers in real time.

Added banner-grabbing fingerprints for 20 common services.
